images.description: Landscape. Three black leather barber chairs at sinks and mirrors against an exposed brick wall, warm pendant lights, patterned tile floor. Empty shop.
Landscape. Three vintage-style barber chairs at wooden stations with mirrors, red brick wall, patterned tile floor, edge of a leather sofa in front.

Wide landscape. Barbershop with vintage chairs along a brick wall, gold mirrors, brown Chesterfield sofas, wood wall with a lion logo reading King's barbershop. Same shop as tX5JNBNSJic, different view.
Landscape. Luxury dark barbershop, low angle on a diamond-quilted brown leather chair, shampoo basin, lit shelves with bottles.
Landscape. Red vintage barber chair in a dark wood-paneled room hung with many framed paintings, moody light.
Landscape. Low angle on a brown tufted leather vintage barber chair, warm lights and wood behind.
Landscape. Row of chrome and black leather barber chairs close up, shampoo basin and tiled floor behind. Muted tones.
Landscape. Barbershop with chrome and black leather chairs on a black-and-white octagon tile floor, framed pictures on the wall.
Landscape. Row of brown leather vintage barber chairs beside a counter with product bottles, checkered floor, red-trimmed walls.
Wide landscape. Busy bright barbershop with three clients in white chairs and striped capes, barbers at wooden stations with mirrors, wood floor.
Landscape. Empty barbershop at night with brown leather chairs, mirrors and lit product shelves. Cool bluish lighting.
Landscape, black and white. Barbershop lounge with a leather sofa and a coffee table of magazines, barber stations and pendant lamps in the back.
Wide landscape. Looking through glass with Chaps & Co lettering into a barbershop where a tattooed barber cuts a client's hair.
Landscape, black and white. Barbershop with string lights on the ceiling, a man standing beside a barber chair.

Portrait. Row of chrome and black leather vintage barber chairs on a dark wood floor, moody light.

Portrait. Black barber chair in front of a gold-framed mirror on a red brick wall, wooden shelf, dark wood floor.
Portrait. Bright industrial barbershop with rows of burgundy leather barber chairs, a black-and-white striped wall, products on a table in front.
Portrait. Modern dark industrial barbershop (Chaps & Co sign) with several barbers cutting clients' hair along a row of chairs.
Portrait. Vintage barber chair in an old room, sunlight through open French doors with wooden shutters, framed pictures.
Portrait. Vintage barber chair in a small room with framed artwork, a shelf and a red-and-white hexagon tile floor.
Portrait. Black leather barber chair on a black-and-white checkered floor in a bright white room.
Portrait. Client reclined in a barber chair under a facial steamer, teal paneled wall, gold mirror, wood floor.

Portrait. Ornate barbershop with pink diamond wallpaper, vintage chairs and patterned floor, masked barber working. Same shop as aZBQB-uYosc, different view.
Portrait. Modern barbershop at night, a man sweeping the glossy floor between barber chairs, wood-slat wall.

Portrait. Black barber chair with a striped towel in front of an ornate gold mirror.
Portrait. View through a red door frame into a barbershop with red barber chairs, a barber cutting a client's hair.
Portrait. Two red barber chairs at wood-paneled stations with mirrors. Ferrari horse decals are visible.
Portrait. Old rustic barbershop, worn vintage chair covered in white cloth, terracotta floor, waterfall posters. Authentic but shabby.
Portrait. Dark salon, a chair facing arched mirrors lit by white neon.
Portrait, black and white. Classic barbershop with chairs, sinks and towels, staff working in the back.
Portrait, black and white. Vintage barber chairs seen through a shop window with a diamond grille.
